title: Quasi-compact reduction for a proper-support complex
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let E be bounded with coherent cohomology on X [def-pc-derived-category], with every cohomology sheaf supported on a closed subset proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then there is a quasi-compact open immersion j:X'\hookrightarrow X containing the union of the supports of all cohomology sheaves of E such that f':=f\circ j:X'\to S is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and the canonical map Rf'_*j^*E\to Rf_*E [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is an isomorphism.
